description: This file implements the ApplicationAndroid class, managing Android-specific application lifecycle events, input events, window handling, deep links, and system events within the Cobalt project. It interfaces with Android native components, handles commands via pipes, and integrates with JNI for deep link and system configuration events.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Manages Android application lifecycle, input, window events, deep links, and system events within the Cobalt platform, interfacing with JNI and Android native components.

methods.name: ApplicationAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ApplicationAndroid instance, setting up pipes, JNI references, and enabling required axes.

methods.name: ~ApplicationAndroid
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, signaling application stopping, and closing pipes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes audio sink and other subsystems.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Tears down subsystems and releases resources.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a new window if none exists, associating it with native window and input event generator.

methods.name: DestroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys the specified window and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Polls for system events with a timeout, processing Android commands and input injections.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes the looper to process system events.

methods.name: OnResume
methods.description: Handles application resume event, calling JNI method.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles application suspend event, calling JNI method.

methods.name: ProcessAndroidCommand
methods.description: Reads and processes Android commands from the pipe, updating application state and injecting events accordingly.

methods.name: SendAndroidCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the Android command pipe and manages synchronization.

methods.name: SendAndroidMotionEvent
methods.description: Processes and injects Android motion events into the application.

methods.name: SendAndroidKeyEvent
methods.description: Processes and injects Android key events into the application.

methods.name: ProcessKeyboardInject
methods.description: Reads injected keyboard events and processes them.

methods.name: SendKeyboardInject
methods.description: Sends a keyboard event for injection.

methods.name: HandleDeepLink
methods.description: Handles deep link URLs, injecting deep link events.

methods.name: SendLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Injects a low memory event.

methods.name: OsNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Handles network status changes, injecting corresponding events.

methods.name: SendDateTimeConfigurationChangedEvent
methods.description: Injects a date/time configuration change event.

methods.name: GetOverlayedIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer overlay variable via JNI.

methods.name: GetOverlayedStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string overlay variable via JNI.

methods.name: GetOverlayedBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean overlay variable via JNI.
